title: Eruption of Mount Vesuvius
description:
The catastrophic eruption of **Mount Vesuvius** on August 24, 79 AD destroyed the Roman cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum.

The cities were buried under 4-6 meters of volcanic ash and pumice, preserving them for nearly 1,700 years. Thousands of people died from the eruption.

The excavated ruins provide an extraordinary snapshot of Roman life frozen in time.
